title: Deploy
description: Ship a new version of this app.

git.statusAhead_one: {{count}} commit ahead of what is live
git.statusAhead_other: {{count}} commits ahead of what is live
git.statusAheadUnknown: Newer than what is live, or live from another branch
git.statusNeverDeployed: No deploy of this source recorded yet
git.branchOther: Not the connected branch. Push deploys still follow {{branch}}.
git.noCommits: This branch has no commits yet.
git.degraded: This host does not expose a commit list, so only the head of {{branch}} is shown.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.rollbackDescription: The app will run the previous successful image again.
shortcuts.rollbackConsequence: The current release stops serving once the previous one is healthy.

head_failed_to_build.title: Commit {{sha}} failed to build
head_failed_to_build.detail: Check the build log before deploying again.

webhook_signature_failing.title: Push webhooks are being rejected
webhook_signature_failing.detail: The last webhook delivery had an invalid signature, so pushes are not deploying.

fix_build_settings.title: Check the build settings
fix_build_settings.detail: This looks like a monorepo, or the last build failed on build configuration.

webhook_not_received.title: Turn on deploy on push
webhook_not_received.detail: No webhook delivery has reached this app yet, so pushes will not deploy by themselves.

release_trigger_only.title: Deploys happen on releases only
release_trigger_only.detail: New commits will not deploy automatically. Deploy one from this list when you are ready.

enable_previews.title: Preview every pull request
enable_previews.detail: Pull request events are arriving. Previews give each one a live URL.

add_health_check.title: Add a health check
add_health_check.detail: Without one, a container that starts but does not serve still counts as healthy.

add_deploy_notifications.title: Get told when deploys finish
add_deploy_notifications.detail: Nobody is notified when this app deploys or fails.

approval.protected: {{environment}} is a protected environment. Redeploys and rollbacks of images here wait for approval from another user with deploy rights.
approval.ack: I understand and want to proceed.

image.connectInstead: Deploy from a git repository instead

connect.title: Choose where this app deploys from
connect.repoDescription: Every push can build and deploy. Pick a repository from a connected provider or paste a URL.
connect.imageDescription: Point at an image that is already built and pushed.

pending.title: Changes since the live deploy
pending.none: Nothing differs from the live deploy.
pending.loadFailed: Could not load the pending changes.

schedule.invalid: That date and time is not valid.
schedule.past: Pick a time in the future.

toast.cancelFailed: Could not cancel the scheduled deploy.

list.title: Scheduled deploys
list.description: One-time deploys waiting to run. They respect deploy freezes, gates and approvals like any deploy.
